question: Who among the following was conferred the Ramanujan Prize for Young Mathematicians 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neena Gupta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ramanujan Prize for Young Mathematicians 2021 has been awarded to Neena Gupta.

 
 
• ​Professor Neena Gupta, a mathematician at the ISI-Kolkata, was awarded the 2021 DST-ICTP-IMU Ramanujan Prize for Young Mathematicians from developing countries for her outstanding work in commutative algebra, and affine algebraic geometry.
 
• She is the third woman to receive the prestigious Ramanujan Prize.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ramanujan Prize is awarded annually to a renowned Mathematician who is less than 45 years of age.
 
• It is given by the International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP), Trieste.
 
• It is sponsored by the Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India.
